content: git safe.directory dubious ownership exit 128 occurs when repo files are owned by a different UID than the process running git, git 2.35.2+ CVE-2022-24765 mitigation. Fix: git config --global --add safe.directory PATH for the UID that will run git, scoped per worktree path rather than wildcard on shared hosts. In a worktree-per-feature plus privilege-drop design the worktree owning UID and the dropped-to worker UID must match, or the neutralized git config used by the agent exec needs an explicit safe.directory entry for that worktree path.
